title: Antheia Secures $80 Million Conditional Funding Commitment from Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital
summary_text: Antheia, an advanced biosynthesis company, secured an $80 million conditional funding commitment from the Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital to support domestic manufacturing and onshore critical medicine supply chains.
